node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-zero reciprocal elimination
node.statement: The complete m=16,h=15 order-zero outer HNF chamber is empty on the official (n,p)=(131072,8191) row. The first three Frobenius-reciprocal coefficient equations give eliminants of degrees 11472 and 15296. Their degree-9912 gcd has squarefree radical s(s-1) product_(j=1)^15(s+j), so every common solution has s in F_8191, contradicting the HNF condition.
node.notes: Exact bounded computer algebra, not a field-element scan: the primary resultant construction and an independent companion-matrix/Newton construction reproduce both eliminants, their gcd, and the degree-17 radical. Closes order zero only; order one and global L1 remain open.
